fields.title: Assuta introduces Israel's most advanced radiotherapy technology
fields.bodyHtml:
Radiation has long been used to destroy cancer cells. The process also disrupts the oxidation and reduction reactions inside the cells, which leads to a build-up of incompletely oxidised free radicals. Where irradiation once reached healthy tissue as well and caused complications, treatment today is aimed at the tumour as precisely as possible, so that the surrounding healthy tissue is spared any significant damage.

Radiotherapy technology keeps improving. Newer and more refined systems deliver a stronger and more accurate dose to the tumour, which minimises the effect on healthy cells. These methods are built on computing technology that makes treatment more precise and more effective. Assuta works to maintain high standards and therefore actively adopts advanced technology in its oncology treatment.

Modern radiation therapy is delivered in three dimensions, but the Institute of Radiotherapy in Israel has already developed a four-dimensional format, in which the fourth dimension is the duration of the session. With the new technology the patient no longer has to hold their breath during the procedure. The computing system works by the Monte Carlo method, which is widely used in the space industry and at NASA in particular. Using it, the system calculates the exact position of the tumour and redirects the beam onto its contours as the tumour shifts. Errors and side effects of radiation therapy are offset by continuous real-time monitoring by a Varian system.

The new radiotherapy technology has proved its advantages not only through excellent treatment outcomes but also by shortening the procedure itself. A session now takes no more than ten minutes, and the overall course of treatment is four times shorter. This shortens treatment for the individual patient and also makes radiation therapy available to a greater number of patients. That is why Assuta continues to adopt the newest technologies, to make treatment more effective still.

fields.title: Israel is one of the world's leading countries in cancer treatment
fields.bodyHtml: Detecting a cancer as early as possible with the help of biomarkers is the basis for starting treatment in Israeli clinics in good time. Every year new multi-million grants fund research into fighting cancer. Through the hard work of Israeli oncologists and scientists, cancer therapy is becoming steadily more targeted and more selective. Selective internal radiation therapy is the newest method of treating cancer: nanoparticles that capture malignant cells destroy only the tumour cells and leave normal tissue untouched. The biomedical company Vacciguard continues to develop new methods of cancer immunotherapy.

fields.title: Israel is one of the leading developers of modern diagnostic equipment
fields.bodyHtml: Digital mammography, refined by Israeli radiologists, sharpens the imaging of breast tissue down to the millimetre, which makes it possible to spot the smallest growths at the earliest stages. Three-dimensional coronary angiography gives a detailed spatial image of the vessels of the heart for a more accurate diagnosis of coronary artery disease. The first CT scanner built specifically for the full examination and imaging of the heart was created here. Laboratory systems for studying and sorting cell material and chromosomes in order to diagnose genetic abnormalities have no equivalent anywhere in the world. Scientists from Haifa have created a non-invasive breath test for the early detection of cancer, before the first symptoms appear. A microcamera from the Israeli developers at Given Imaging fits inside a capsule and is widely used for video capsule endoscopy, the most effective method of examining the digestive tract even in places that are hard to reach, such as the middle sections of the small intestine.

fields.title: Israeli doctor: smokers do not simply give up cigarettes, they need an alternative
fields.bodyHtml: Smokers often suffer the consequences of their habit, yet they do not simply stop, even when doctors insistently advise them to. So says Dr Dov Gavish, an atherosclerosis specialist at the Shaare Zedek hospital. In his own column in the newspaper Israel Hayom, Gavish explains that he has often asked patients to stop smoking, but many of them never did, however much he frightened or pleaded with them. He points out that the «official» share of smokers in the Israeli population has not changed for ten years, holding at 20 per cent. In practice this means that the absolute number of smokers is rising, because the population keeps growing. As the doctor notes, many countries, among them Britain, New Zealand and Japan, are officially introducing an «alternative» to tobacco products (electronic cigarettes, apparently). In those countries the share of smokers really is falling. In Israel, by contrast, officials hold that all smoking products are equally harmful, and the very idea that ordinary cigarettes might be replaced by other nicotine options is repugnant to the civil servants leading the campaign against smoking. Because the state fights smoking through prohibition alone, that fight is bearing no fruit, Dov Gavish believes, and what is happening with cannabis proves the point once again. Only when smokers are given an accessible alternative will there be results. He therefore urges the authorities to change the record and stop treating the very idea of an «alternative» to smoking as being as sacrilegious as smoking itself.

fields.title: The beauty of your skin depends entirely on the health of your gut
fields.bodyHtml:
Did you know that problems with your skin are an indicator that your gut is not working as it should?

We are ready to spend a great deal of time and money fighting a dull complexion, spots, irritation, dryness, flaking and so on. Yet even the most expensive branded cosmetic preparation will be powerless if the problem lies inside the body.

The skin is a kind of mirror in which everything happening inside the body can be seen, and the digestive organs in particular. The condition of the skin is affected by various environmental influences and also by irregular eating, which disturbs the gut microflora: disease-causing micro-organisms multiply unchecked, release toxins and pass through the intestinal wall, spreading to the body's other organs. The result is dysbiosis or intoxication. As an organ of elimination, the skin is the first to respond to unfavourable processes in the body, and as a consequence it loses its natural qualities, becoming oily and vulnerable and difficult to care for.

Skin problems may be accompanied by constipation, one of the principal and most unpleasant symptoms of a disturbed gut microflora. Constipation can lead to irreversible health problems. Because of the prolonged delay, the stool sets off pathogenic processes in the body which reach the bloodstream, and this too shows in the condition of the skin.

To restore the health of the gut and, along with it, the condition of the skin, it is necessary to take preparations containing lactulose, a prebiotic that encourages the development of a healthy gut microflora. On reaching the intestine, lactulose feeds the beneficial lactic acid bacteria and stimulates their growth.

Before taking any preparation, however, the digestive organs should be examined in order to identify the cause of the imbalance, assess the state of health and determine the most suitable treatment.
